d: An anthropomorphic reptilian creature with a lean, athletic build, featuring a long, thick purple tail with darker violet spots. The head is elongated with a pointed snout, small white eyes, and a large, swept-back crest of deep purple scales. The attire consists of ornate gold and teal armor plating on the shoulders, chest, and hips, paired with a white under-tunic and dark teal accents. The creature holds a long wooden spear topped with a jagged, glowing emerald-green crystal blade. BODY COLOR: Pale lavender-grey with deep purple markings and a dark purple tail. LEGS: Digitigrade with three-toed, clawed dark purple feet.
